strategies.name: pre_market_level_breakout_continuation
strategies.entry_summary: After 3:00 a.m. ET, mark the pre-market high or low on the 5-minute chart, then enter in the direction of a clean breakout when price closes beyond that level. The speaker also specifies confirmation from elevated volume, with optional order-flow confirmation, and says he may use a 1-minute or 2-min
strategies.exit_summary: Place the stop on the opposite side of the breakout candle. Manage the trade by taking at least 1R to 2R, then trail the stop toward breakeven or into profit and scale out as price continues in favor.

variants.confirmation_mechanic_note: wait for a candle close beyond the pre-market high/low with rising volume
variants.target_note: aim for at least 1R, ideally 1.5R to 2R
variants.transcript_quote: if you were the breakout trader in this scenario, you would go long at the close of this two-minute candle

variants.confirmation_mechanic_note: same breakout-close logic on a faster lower timeframe
variants.target_note: aim for at least 1R, ideally 1.5R to 2R
variants.transcript_quote: you could even play around with a 1 minute

strategies.name: pre_market_level_break_and_retest_reversal
strategies.entry_summary: After the pre-market high or low breaks, wait for price to pull back and retest that level from the other side, then enter on the retest confirmation in the breakout direction. The speaker frames this as turning the prior high into support or the prior low into resistance.
strategies.exit_summary: Stop goes just beyond the retested level / opposite side of the entry candle. Manage toward at least 1R and preferably 1.5R to 2R, then trail and scale out as the move develops.

strategies.name: pre_market_level_liquidity_sweep_reversal
strategies.entry_summary: At a pre-market high or low, wait for a brief false break or sweep through the level that fails and then reclaims it. Enter in the reversal direction once the reclaim is confirmed, treating the sweep as a trap for breakout traders and stop-runs.
strategies.exit_summary: Stop goes beyond the sweep candle or beyond the reclaimed level on the opposite side of the entry. The trade is then managed for at least 1R and ideally 1.5R to 2R, with stop progression to breakeven or in profit as price expands.

enumeration_note: Three distinct executable strategies are taught: breakout continuation, break-and-retest continuation, and liquidity-sweep reversal. The breakout strategy has lower-timeframe variants (1m/2m) that are compatible configuration differences.
